card.title: The factory map on the Overview: stages and hand-offs, live, with details on click
The board: every item in the column of its stage, with round, live step, returns and landed time
The item page: an item's timeline of runs and rounds, its asks, links and change
A read-only page of a project's items with each item's live progress (running step, round, returns, change)
Stage and step pages: a stage's workflows as step graphs, and a step's prompt and YAML
